thread.title: UPDATE: Apple makes history with $1 trillion market cap, but take a look at what happened to the first company to get there

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: Apple makes history with $1 trillion market cap, but take a look at what happened to the first company to get there
text:
By Shawn Langlois, MarketWatch
Be careful what you wish for.
Apple(AAPL) , much to the joy of shareholders and fanboys everywhere, has become the first U.S. company to reach a valuation of $1 trillion. A nice earnings beat (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-earnings-show-why-you-can-expect-more-1000-iphones-2018-07-31) was met with a two-day stock-market surge to give Apple the back-stretch boost it needed to beat Amazon(AMZN)to this lofty level.
Globally, however, the 13-figure mark was apparently breached more than a decade ago, when PetroChina(0857.HK)enjoyed a face-melting debut in Shanghai. But the celebration didn't last long, as you can see by this chart:
Bloomberg calculated that the collapse (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-10-29/the-biggest-stock-collapse-in-world-history-has-no-end-in-sight), which it called "the biggest stock slump in world history," cost shareholders about $800 billion, thanks to government attempts to limit the kind of speculation that led to that initial surge.
Of course, similarities with Apple pretty much begin and end with that $1 trillion valuation, although PetroChina's implosion in Shanghai is a reminder of the brutal and finicky nature of stock markets.
Apple's stock, changing hands at $190 just 48 hours ago, needed to clear $207.04, based on its update after the closing bell Wednesday of this week of its share count (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-updates-share-count-as-it-closes-is-on-1-trillion-market-cap-2018-08-01), to see the company's market capitalization eclipse the $1 trillion mark. It closed Thursday at $207.39.
See also:Apple path to $1 trillion accelerates as consumers flock to pricey iPhones (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-path-to-1-trillion-accelerates-as-consumers-flock-to-pricey-iphones-2018-08-01)
-Shawn Langlois; 02-18 1643ET
